title: deferred-shadow-buffer-and-replay-rollout-controller
author: Aisha Khanna
description: Motivation: Some model regressions (e.g., delayed coherence drift, rare token hallucinations, multi-turn state corruption) manifest only after a short window of downstream interactions. Immediate canary signals can miss these delayed failure modes and either produce false negatives or force overly conservative rollouts. This PR introduces a Deferred Shadow Buffer + Replay Rollout Controller that captures a configurable sample of shadow requests, buffers their inputs and immediate responses for a short evaluation window, and then replays them asynchronously against candidate model variants to compute delayed-signal metrics and a deterministic rollback score. Main goals: (1) give operators a lightweight way to detect delayed degradations before completing a traffic promotion, (2) enable A/B evaluations where metric windows differ (e.g., immediate latency vs. 5-minute coherence checks), and (3) provide an operator-friendly simulator to estimate rollback probability over historical traffic. Changes in this PR: implemented a rollout controller that manages a per-cohort shadow buffer with TTL and replay policies; added a replay-based metric sink that computes windowed deltas (supporting mean/percentile and custom loss functions); integrated a rollback score calculator with configurable thresholds and weightings; added a deterministic simulator that can run a replay pass against stored traffic (used in CI and by SRE to estimate risk); surface new rollout knobs in the API (api/v1/rollout_types.go) and console docs. Backwards compatibility: the controller defaults to a disabled shadow buffer; enabling requires opt-in in the rollout spec. Checkout checklist: - implement controller + buffer (controllers/deferred_shadow_controller.go) - add simulator (pkg/simulator/replay_sim.go) - expose API fields and validation (api/v1/rollout_types.go) - add e2e test harness and CI job (test/e2e/deferred_shadow_replay_test.go) - docs and console notes (docs/rollouts/deferred-shadow.md). Testing summary: unit tests for buffer correctness and TTL, integration test that drives replay and asserts expected rollback_score computation, e2e experiment against a synthetic historical corpus to check simulator stability. Risks and mitigations: buffer growth under heavy traffic mitigated by stochastic sampling and dynamic rate cap; possible metric misalignment mitigated by conservative default thresholds and an evaluation-only "simulation" mode that runs fast but does not block promotions. Usage notes: the rollout spec accepts shadow.buffer_size, shadow.sample_rate, shadow.replay_delay, and rollback.score_threshold; recommended default values included in docs. Related work: builds on prior staged-rollout and shadowing infra but focuses on delayed-signal detection and deterministic replay to support safe promotions. The description below contains a short example of a rollout snippet: {"rollout_strategy": "deferred-shadow", "shadow": {"sample_rate": 0.05, "buffer_ttl_seconds": 300, "replay_delay_seconds": 120}, "rollback": {"score_threshold": 0.8}}. Please see the changed files for implementation details and the simulator for how to run historical risk estimates.

review_comments: Marco Diaz (reviewer): Can we avoid storing full request payloads in the buffer? Suggest storing a normalized fingerprint and replay seed to reduce memory. Which sensitive fields are redacted?

Aisha Khanna (author): We store a sanitized request plus a small provenance envelope. Sensitive fields are redacted via existing request-sanitizer pipeline; I added a unit to validate redaction and updated the docs to call out redaction rules.
Lina Zhao (reviewer): The rollback_score uses a weighted sum of metric deltas. Would be good to add a configurable smoothing window and expose weights via the rollout spec for experiments.
Aisha Khanna (author): Added smoothing_window_ms and exposed metric_weights in the spec. Default weights keep latency lower-priority to avoid false positives on noisy networks.
Evan Park (reviewer): e2e flakes observed on nightly due to simulator relying on local timezone and time.Now() in tests. Please inject clock interface for determinism.
Aisha Khanna (author): Rewrote simulator to use injected clock; e2e now deterministically seeds replay runs in CI.
Marco Diaz (approver): LGTM after minor nits; please follow up with a separate PR to add observability metrics for buffer size and replay latency.
Lina Zhao (approver): Approved - the simulation harness is useful for SRE risk analysis.
merge_outcome: merged via squash and merge; commit message: 'deferred shadow buffer + replay rollout controller: enable delayed-signal detection and deterministic rollback simulation (ENG-3477)'
release_notes: Operator-facing: add 'deferred-shadow' rollout strategy with buffered shadowing and replay-based rollback scoring; defaults off; see docs/rollouts/deferred-shadow.md for sample spec and recommended defaults.
notes_for_followup: 1) Add buffer metrics and console visualization (follow-up ticket ENG-3521). 2) Add an opt-in HSM-backed scrubber for PII-heavy request shapes (security follow-up). 3) Run a 7-day internal experiment with traffic from two major cohorts before org-wide rollout.
risk_assessment: medium: new infra path but disabled by default; simulation and conservative defaults reduce blast radius. Sampling and caps prevent unbounded memory growth.
